data.long_meaning: One who provides comfort and tranquility. The name Karrum carries the meaning “Comforting, Soothing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Karrum usually hope their child will grow to embody comforting, soothing and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Karrum total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

This name not only reflects the attributes of an individual but also highlights the importance of caring for one another within the Islamic culture.

The emotional and spiritual connection to this name provides a sense of peace, security, and serenity, inspiring individuals to uplift and support others in their daily lives.

historical_references.context: According to some historical accounts, the Prophet Muhammad and his companions were forced to flee Mecca and migrated to Medina (al-Madinah al-Munawwara) in 622 CE, an event known as the Hijra. The city played a significant role in the early Islamic expansion and was an important center for Islamic learning and culture.
